description: Sewerage Network Basins is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. This layer delineates sewer catchments upstream of retail water company hydraulic information points. Sewer catchments which contribute directly to Melbourne Water assets are also included. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Its tags are basin, boundary, melbourne-water, sewer-catchments, sewerage. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
